business_summary: Jiangsu Lianhuan Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells pharmaceuticals, preparations, and active pharmaceutical ingredients (API) products in China and internationally. The company offers clopidogrel bisulfate tablets, doxycycline hydrochloride, azithromycin, dapoxetine hydrochloride, milrinone injection, aprilite, ebastine tablets, felodipine tablets, tadalafil, and betasine besylate tablets, as well as danazol suppositories, drapavelin hydrochloride injection, and terfenadine tablets. It also provides urinary system drugs, including eprepitant tablets, terazosin tablets, and drotaverine hydrochloride injections; antihistamines comprising terfenadine, and cetirizine hydrochloride tablets; cardiovascular drugs that include felodipine, simvastatin, and amlodipine maleate tablets; steroid hormones, which consist of prazosinone sulfate sodium for injection and danazol capsules; and antibiotics, such as oxithromycin capsules. In addition, the company offers API products, such as hydrocortisone, hydrocortisone acetate, levonorgestrel, dexamethasone sodium phosphate, dexamethasone acetate, tazarotene, saxagliptin monohydrate, sacubitril valsartan sodium, adapalene, milrinone, phentolamine mesylate, terfenadine, aminomethylbenzoic acid, lumbrokinase, chloramphenicol, balofoxacin, fludrocortisone acetate, relugolix, bilastine, crisaborole, argatroban, hexyl aminolevulinate hydrochloride, finerenone, enarodustat, dotinurad, methylprednisolone succinate, hydrocortisone sodium succinate, arotinolol hydrochloride, darlotamide, adapalene, triamcinolone acetonide acetate, baloxavir marboxil, acetoacetate methylprednisolone, vericiguat, and pemafibrate. Further, it engages in the wholesale of chemical raw materials and pharmaceuticals, as well as the sale of medical equipment and electronic products. The company exports its products. Jiangsu Lianhuan Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd. was founded in 1999 and is based in Yangzhou, China.
business_summary_ko: Jiangsu Lianhuan Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd.는 자회사와 함께 중국 및 국제적으로 의약품, 제제 및 활성 의약품 성분(API) 제품을 제조 및 판매합니다. 회사는 클로피도그렐 황산수소정, 독시사이클린염산염, 아지스로마이신, 다폭세틴염산염, 밀리논주사제, 아프릴라이트, 에바스틴정, 펠로디핀정, 타다라필, 베타신베실레이트정, 다나졸좌약, 드라파벨린염산염주사제, 테르페나딘정 등을 판매하고 있다. 또한 에프레피탄트(eprepitant) 정제, 테라조신(terazosin) 정제, 드로타베린 염산염 주사제를 포함한 비뇨기계 약물도 제공합니다. 테르페나딘 및 세티리진 염산염 정제를 포함하는 항히스타민제; 펠로디핀, 심바스타틴 및 암로디핀 말레에이트 정제를 포함하는 심혈관 약물; 주사용 프라조시논황산나트륨과 다나졸 캡슐로 구성된 스테로이드 호르몬; 및 옥시트로마이신 캡슐과 같은 항생제. 또한 회사는 하이드로코르티손, 하이드로코르티손 아세테이트, 레보노르게스트렐, 덱사메타손 인산나트륨, 덱사메타손 아세테이트, 타자로틴, 삭사글립틴 일수화물, 사쿠비트릴 발사르타와 같은 API 제품을 제공합니다.
